status: one post-v1 development revision; not independent confirmation or a preregistration
motivation: v1 traces prioritized the near-tied top pair while delaying broad partial certification

forecast.continuation: constant future paired differences equal current paired sample mean, zero at n=0
forecast.starting_evidence: copies of actual current capitals and historical peaks
forecast.hit_rule: same guarded directional-XOR betting threshold, pair-prefix deterministic completion, or census
forecast.ahead_system_scores: excluded from the forecast; no bound or compatibility claim
forecast.cache: invalidate forecasts when paired-prefix count changes
forecast.interpretation: a plug-in forecast, not expected annotation cost or statistical evidence

primary_outcomes: any wrong certificate anywhere in a run
cost to certify 90 percent of pairs
secondary_outcomes: certificate cost for the full-data top-two pair (evaluation-only)
top-two resolved fraction at half budget
data_and_seeds: same six synthetic scenarios x 100 replicates and same exposed cs-de matrix x 20 seeds as protocol.json
comparison_execution: reuse the previously audited paired v1 baseline records, with matching seeds and source hashes; run only the new policy

gate.efficiency: retain the original development gate: at least 10 percent cost90 savings against BOTH random_pair and common_active on the real development matrix
gate.tradeoffs: report all synthetic scenarios, full-ranking costs, early-budget certificates and top-two delay, even when unfavorable
gate.meaning: an internal go/no-go criterion, not an ACL standard or proof of generalization

scope: no private collaborative or SAFE-EVAL code
no tuning or candidate replacement after seeing v2 results
do not imply partial certification identifies the best system
